fichas.h1: Rock Marble Coffee Table by Rugiano

fichas.descripcion:
Designed by Rugiano, the Rock is a low coffee table with a shaped top and two legs in bronzed brass metal. Made in Italy, this Rugiano coffee table comes in two different sizes.

WOOD OR MARBLE TOP

You can order the wood table with a Decoro decorated painted top, or the marble table with a top from the wide range of marble options.

It is a low table made to sit in front of a sofa, so match the size to its length. See all coffee tables.
fichas.descripcion_original: The Italian Rock coffee table features a stylish shaped top available in Decoro decorated painted wood or in a wide range of marble options. This versatile low table, available in two different sizes, has two refined legs made of bronzed brass metal. An innovative and functional coffee table to complement sophisticated sofas. Designed by Rugiano. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Hermes Maxi Upholstered King Bed by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion:
The Hermes Maxi is an upholstered king bed by DV Home Collection, made in Italy, with a large headboard in vertical quilting.

FABRIC OR LEATHER

  • Fabric: a wide range of fabrics.
  • Leather: a wide range of leathers.

STRUCTURE AND CUSHIONS

The Hermes bed is built on a multilayer structure covered with non-deformable polyurethane foam. Goose feather square decorative cushions in two sizes are available on request.

Upholstery is the main decision to make on the Maxi bed; compare it with other king beds if you want a different headboard shape.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Part of the Italian Hermes collection, this double bed is offered with a multilayer structure covered with non-deformable polyurethane foam.

The upholstery is offered in a wide range of fabric or leather options and the large headboard features a refined vertical quilting. Also, to add more comfort, goose feather square decorative cushions (19”5/8 or 15”3/4) are available upon request.

Elegance and Glamour characterize this versatile Italian furniture piece. Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Tiffany Multilayered Wall Mirror by DV Home Collection
fichas.descripcion:
The Tiffany is a wall mirror by DV Home Collection with a multilayered structure and a natural mirror surface. Made in Italy. This Tiffany style mirror comes with a frame in six finishes, from shining stainless steel and chrome black to 24Kt gold.

SIX FRAME FINISHES

  • Antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, shining stainless steel, chrome black, or 24Kt gold.

Tiffany mirrors let you choose the finish, while the natural mirror surface stays the same. See all wall mirrors.

The refined frame is offered in shining stainless steel, antique bronze satin, shaded glossy, shaded satin, chrome black or dipped in 24Kt gold. This luxury Italian piece will surely add a Glamour style to any interior space. Made in Italy.

validacion.razon: Todos los datos coinciden con la ficha: estructura multicapa, superficie de espejo natural, Made in Italy y las seis opciones de acabado están correctamente contadas y enumeradas. THREE SEATS OUTSIDE

This Cruise couch seats three, so it fits a large terrace or garden living area. To compare this Talenti sofa with other models, browse our outdoor sofas.

fichas.h1: Illan Wood Wall Sconce by Luceplan
fichas.descripcion:
Designed by Zsuzsanna Horvath, the Luceplan Illan lamp is a wood wall sconce. A die-cast aluminum body holds an LED that lights upward through a laser-cut layered wood shade. Made in Italy.

SURPLUS WOOD SHADE

The shade is laser-cut from wood left over from making the Illan suspension, so each wood sconce turns production scraps into a thin, flexible silhouette.

LED AND DIMMING

  • LED 21W, 1265lm, 2700K or 3000K, CRI 90, dimmable.
  • UL Approved, built to National Electrical Code requirements.

Hang it where a table lamp would take up surface space, and browse our wall sconces to compare formats.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Illan wall lamp brings the poetic lightness and innovative spirit of Zsuzsanna Horvath’s design into a refined, space-saving format. This elegant wall light features a die-cast aluminum body housing an efficient LED source that casts a soft, warm glow upward, enriching interiors with atmospheric, eco-friendly illumination. Its distinctive shade is crafted from laser-cut, layered wood, an ultra-thin and flexible material that defines Illan’s iconic geometric silhouette. In a commitment to sustainable design, the wooden element is made from surplus material left over from producing the Illan suspension lamp, transforming production scraps into a sculptural, decorative feature.

Lightweight, contemporary, and environmentally conscious, the Illan wall lamp is a perfect choice for those seeking designer wall lighting, warm LED ambience, and Italian craftsmanship that merges technology, beauty, and sustainability. UL Approved (Product build according to the National Electrical Code’s requirements and tested by Underwriters Laboratories). Made in Italy.

Light source: LED 21W 1265lm 2700K/3000K CRI 90 Dimmable. UL Approved.

The Steinway is an Italian piano by Riva Mobili D'Arte, with hand-carved decoration on the base and sides and mother-of-pearl inlays set into the surface.

CARVING AND INLAY

The decoration on the base and sides is carved by hand, and the mother-of-pearl reflects light in iridescent shades that change with the angle.

IN A ROOM

Because the ornament runs along the base and sides, a luxury interior piano like this one can stand away from a wall. Pair it with plain furniture: a contemporary luxury piano already carries enough decoration. Browse more Riva Mobili D'Arte pianos.

Every detail reveals exceptional artisanal mastery: from the harmonious structure to the rich, refined carvings that adorn the base and sides. The hand-carved decorations embody timeless artistry and lend the instrument an aura of grandeur and prestige. This piano is a true work of art, a symbol of an era when manual skill and aesthetic taste achieved a level of absolute perfection. Made in Italy.

fichas.descripcion:
The Shibari is a Visionnaire armchair, fully covered in stretch fabric, with a continuous, enveloping silhouette. Curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest and form a fluid knot.

THE KNOT

The knot links rather than restrains: in this piece of Shibari furniture, the legs and backrest merge into one intertwined line, and the symbol carries the design.

SEAT AND STRUCTURE

A high-density polyurethane core and a webbed seat keep it comfortable while the frame stays visually light. The stretch cover wraps the whole chair, so this fabric armchair reads as one continuous form. Comparing Shibari chairs, look at how the tubes meet the back. See all upholstered chairs and armchairs.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Shibari chair comes fully covered in stretch fabric, featuring a continuous and enveloping silhouette. The curved tubular metal legs converge at the backrest, forming a fluid knot that merges structure and formal expression. The high-density polyurethane core and webbed seat ensure comfort and support, striking a balance between visual lightness and structural solidity.

Across history the knot has had many different meanings, including sacred and religious symbolism. In Egypt it represented life: the knot of Isis stood for immortality and divine love. The endless knot is one of the most ancient figures utilized in Buddhist symbolism in China and Tibet, but also in geographically distant zones, to convey a sense of infinite devotion. Tying and knotting mean joining, connecting two objects, bringing them together in harmonious progress. Since ancient times the knot has had a clear meaning of junction and commitment between two people. This meaning is immediately associated with love, precisely to emphasize the inseparable nature of a bond.

This symbol conveys meanings of eternity and faithfulness. A knot made properly will not come undone, opening and separating the two objects it holds fast. Therefore a love knot unites two people forever. It is not a noose, not a tight restraint, but an intertwined connection, representing a sense of give and take, of help in moments of need. It is a soft knot that links without duress. Extended horizontally, it reminds us of the symbol of infinity: what could be a better way to represent everlasting love?

Solo hay una leve repetición de la idea de forma continua, insuficiente para rechazar.
